decisions.reason: The Air Quality Bricklet is a flagship sensing module with its own page and a public launch announcement, and the firm has invested in its firmware and bindings, so management will keep it as part of the announced platform expansion.

Analog In 3.0 is the current generation that replaced 2.0 under the firm's stated hardware update path, so dropping it would contradict that path, although a newer generation could eventually succeed it.
The CAN bus module extends the firm's committed connectivity offering for automation customers and needs little to maintain, so there is no strong reason to write it off.
The CO2 Bricklet has a dedicated page and an investment in sensor integration, and demand for CO2 monitoring stayed strong, so management will keep it on the market.
